points.description: Names the three items learned in an RBF network: centers, weights, and biases (in any wording, e.g. centre positions, output weights, bias term).
points.partial_credit: Half if two of the three items are given correctly.

points.description: Gives a difference from other NNs and/or a pro or con of RBFN, e.g. single hidden layer with linear output (vs. multiple hidden layers/non-linear output), universal approximator, easy to add centers, or bias not unique.
points.partial_credit: Half if only a vague or partial comparison/pro/con is given, or only one of difference or pros/cons is mentioned very briefly.

rubric.notes: Full marks: the three learned items (centers, weights, biases) plus a correct difference or pro/con of RBFN in any wording. Part marks: two of the three items, or a vague comparison or pro/con. No marks for wrong or off-topic content; extra incorrect remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict the main idea.
